articles.title: Airbus met la main sur Quarkslab, le français qui protège les logiciels contre l'IA
articles.text:
Airbus annonce jeudi avoir finalisé le rachat de Quarkslab, entreprise française de cybersécurité connue pour sa solution QShield, qui protège les logiciels face à l'IA. L'opération, révélée en avril, renforce la stratégie cyber du groupe européen.
Le rachat de Quarkslab par Airbus a franchi la ligne d'arrivée ce jeudi 1er octobre, puisqu'Airbus Defence and Space a annoncé avoir finalisé l'opération, sous réserve comme le veut la règle des ultimes autorisations réglementaires. Un peu plus de cinq mois se sont écoulés depuis l'annonce d'avril, et le prix de la transaction n'a toujours pas été dévoilé. Mais pour l'avionneur européen, il s'agit de consolider sa position de partenaire de confiance et souverain des autorités françaises, tout en gagnant du terrain sur le marché européen de la cybersécurité.
La solution tout-en-un pour protéger votre entreprise
Votre petite entreprise a de grandes ambitions. Protégez-là contre les pirates. Et développez sereinement votre activité !
Quarkslab, la cybersécurité qui ne se laisse pas démonter
Alors quelle est cette société que s'offre Airbus ? Quarkslab, fondée en 2011 par Fred Raynal, ce dernier n'étant plus que le conseiller stratégique de l'entreprise, compte une centaine de salariés, installés principalement à Paris et à Rennes, la capitale française de la cybersécurité. Elle est soutenue depuis 2020 par le gestionnaire d'actifs Tikehau Capital, lui aussi très présent dans la cyber. Sa spécialité est de protéger les utilisateurs, données et actifs critiques contre les cyberattaques. Avec son équipe d'experts maison, QLab, elle conçoit des protections sur mesure pour des États comme pour des entreprises. Ses ingénieurs et développeurs ont la particularité de faire dialoguer recherche universitaire et applications concrètes.
Le produit phare que vend Quarkslab, QShield, s'adresse aux éditeurs de logiciels. Il protège leurs programmes contre les menaces liées à l'intelligence artificielle et met sous clé code, données et secrets. Il défend aussi les composants dits « périphériques », installés au plus près du terrain plutôt que dans un centre de données, contre la rétro-ingénierie.
Cette technique consiste à démonter un système pour comprendre son fonctionnement, un peu comme on ouvrirait une montre pour copier son mouvement, si l'on devait comparer. Les pirates, comme l'IA, peuvent s'y livrer, notamment dans la défense et l'aérospatiale.
Airbus coud son bouclier numérique à l'échelle européenne
Pour Airbus, il faut savoir que Quarkslab n'est pas une entreprise inconnue, loin de là. L'entreprise faisait déjà partie de ses fournisseurs et partenaires. Fred Raynal a même fait ses premières armes dans la cyber au sein du groupe. Lors de l'annonce du mois d'avril, il avait reconnu que l'Europe avait besoin d'acteurs plus solides. Selon lui, Airbus faisait partie des rares capables d'aider Quarkslab à grandir pour servir à la fois les États et les infrastructures critiques.
François Lombard, le directeur de la division Connected Intelligence d'Airbus Defence and Space, voit les équipes de Quarkslab renforcer des activités cyber en pleine croissance. Selon lui, l'acquisition aide à bâtir le « bouclier numérique » qui doit garder les pays d'origine du groupe et leurs alliés en avance dans ce domaine.
Après l'allemand Infodas en 2024 et le britannique Ultra Cyber, dont le rachat a été annoncé en mars dernier, Airbus dispose d'équipes cyber en France, au Royaume-Uni, en Allemagne, en Espagne et en Finlande. Elles sécurisent les systèmes et réseaux complexes que le groupe fournit principalement aux États, aux armées et aux institutions.

articles.title: Hackers cuelan malware en una versión falsa de ChatGPT dentro de la web oficial de la IA
articles.text:
Un grupo de ciberdelincuentes desarrolló una campaña de malware que utiliza una herramienta legítima de OpenAI para engañar a sus víctimas y tomar control remoto de sus computadoras, incluidas la cámara y el micrófono. La firma de ciberseguridad Huntress detectó la operación y logró que se diera de baja, pero dos días después surgió una réplica con el mismo método.
El engaño se apoya en Custom GPT, una función de ChatGPT que permite configurar una versión personalizada del asistente con instrucciones, archivos y capacidades propias, además de un nombre y una personalidad específicos. Como estos GPT quedan alojados en el dominio chatgpt.com, quienes acceden a través de un enlace recibido por correo electrónico o mensajería instantánea no tienen motivos para sospechar, dado que la dirección web corresponde a la página oficial de OpenAI.
PUBLICIDAD
Los atacantes bautizaron su creación como “Plus 5.6”, un nombre que imita la nomenclatura real de los modelos de la compañía, como GPT-3.5 o GPT-5 Pro, con el objetivo de resultar creíble ante usuarios que no siguen de cerca la evolución de la industria de la inteligencia artificial. Este GPT fue programado para responder siempre con el mismo mensaje, sin importar la consigna que se le escriba: un aviso que indica una supuesta “disponibilidad limitada en el dominio principal” y que redirige a un “dominio de respaldo”.
Un falso control de seguridad
Ese enlace alternativo lleva a un sitio construido con Google Sites, un servicio gratuito y legítimo pensado para crear páginas web sin necesidad de programar. Su uso, en este caso, busca reforzar la apariencia de legitimidad del engaño, aunque un usuario atento podría notar que carece de sentido que OpenAI recurriera a una herramienta de Google para gestionar un dominio de respaldo cuando podría hacerlo con sus propios recursos.
PUBLICIDAD
Al ingresar a esta página, se revela el verdadero propósito de la operación: aparece un falso control de verificación tipo CAPTCHA de Cloudflare que solicita al visitante copiar y pegar un fragmento de código en el programa “Ejecutar” de Windows. Esta secuencia corresponde a la técnica conocida como ClickFix, que consiste en presentar a la víctima un problema ficticio junto con una solución inmediata para inducirla a ejecutar comandos maliciosos por sí misma.
Control casi total del equipo
La ejecución de ese código descarga e instala un troyano de acceso remoto (RAT) que Huntress identificó bajo el nombre “@input”. Este programa malicioso da a los atacantes la posibilidad de ver la pantalla de la víctima y operar el dispositivo de forma remota, además de activar la cámara web, el micrófono y el audio del sistema para vigilar y escuchar sin que el usuario lo perciba.
PUBLICIDAD
El malware también permite rastrear el contenido de archivos y documentos almacenados en el equipo en busca de información valiosa. Antes de eso, realiza un reconocimiento inicial del sistema: verifica qué software de seguridad está instalado, qué programas se encuentran en ejecución y cómo está conectado el dispositivo a la red.
Según los investigadores, la herramienta puede además descargar y ejecutar componentes adicionales y otras variantes de software malicioso, algo que ocurrió en la mayoría de los casos analizados sin que las víctimas lo advirtieran.
Para no ser detectado, “@input” se comunica con sus operadores mediante canales cifrados que se camuflan dentro del tráfico web habitual, de acuerdo con lo señalado por Huntress. Los investigadores agregaron que la herramienta parece formar parte de un marco de trabajo mantenido de forma profesional.
PUBLICIDAD
La compañía de ciberseguridad precisó que la campaña afectó a “decenas” de usuarios y que su equipo de operaciones de seguridad respondió a al menos 40 incidentes vinculados al dominio específico de Google Sites utilizado en este ataque. Tras ser contactada por los investigadores, OpenAI dio de baja el GPT personalizado “Plus 5.6” el 25 de septiembre. Sin embargo, dos días más tarde apareció un nuevo GPT con características similares, lo que indica que la operación continúa activa pese a las medidas tomadas.

articles.title: Samsung dévoile ses premiers écouteurs ouverts, les Galaxy Buds On
articles.text:
En parallèle des Galaxy Tab S12 et du SmartTag 3, Samsung a discrètement dévoilé les écouteurs Galaxy Buds On. Pour être plus précis, il s’agit d’écouteurs ouverts qui doivent être clippés à l’oreille. Leur objectif : diffuser un son de qualité, tout en permettant à l’utilisateur de continuer à entendre son environnement. À noter que c’est la première fois que Samsung propose des écouteurs ouverts pour sa marque Galaxy.
Samsung promet un son immersif, sans couper l’utilisateur du monde
Pour ses premiers écouteurs ouverts, Samsung explique avoir notamment analysé différents types de formes d’oreilles et optimisé l’élasticité de l’arceau pour maintenir les écouteurs en place, même lorsque l’utilisateur est en mouvement. Par ailleurs, il est possible de contrôler des fonctions de base, comme la lecture de la musique et les appels, avec une simple pression à l’arrière des écouteurs.
Côté qualité sonore, les Buds On sont équipés de haut-parleurs TwinBoost conçus pour offrir des basses plus présentes, malgré leur conception ouverte. Par ailleurs, les Galaxy Buds On embarquent la plateforme audio Snapdragon S7 Gen 1 de Qualcomm ainsi qu’un amplificateur de classe D conçu pour offrir une bonne puissance sonore tout en limitant la consommation d’énergie.
Les écouteurs proposent un contrôle automatique du volume qui s’adapte à l’environnement sonore, ainsi qu’une fonction de réduction des fuites audio. Précisons tout de même qu’ils n’intègrent pas de fonction de réduction de bruit ; leur rôle étant justement que l’utilisateur reste conscient de son environnement, tout en écoutant de la musique. Samsung promet par ailleurs des appels clairs grâce à sa technologie Clear Call. Celle-ci repose sur trois microphones, un capteur de conduction osseuse et de l’intelligence artificielle afin d’isoler la voix de l’utilisateur des bruits ambiants.
Fonctionnalités IA, autonomie et prix
Avec les appareils compatibles Galaxy AI, les Buds On intègrent l’assistant IA Gemini, activable par une simple commande vocale. La fonction Mémo vocal permet quant à elle d’enregistrer un mémo vocal en appuyant longuement sur la zone tactile de l’écouteur. Il est par ailleurs possible de contrôler les écouteurs avec des gestes de la tête. Enfin, côté autonomie, Samsung annonce jusqu’à 9,5 heures d’écoute musicale en continu avec une seule charge.
Les Galaxy Buds On seront disponibles en Corée du Sud le 27 octobre au prix d’environ 220 $. Un seul coloris est proposé : noir. Samsung explique que « leur commercialisation sur les marchés internationaux suivra progressivement », sans donner plus de précisions. Le constructeur sud-coréen annonce néanmoins que davantage d’informations seront partagées le 27 octobre.

articles.title: Some Pixel owners can't unlock their phones after the latest update
articles.text:
What we know so far: A growing number of Pixel owners say the September 2026 update has left them unable to unlock their phones, even when they enter the correct PIN or pattern. The problem appears to be in the lock screen itself. Some users say their pattern resets after they connect one or two dots, making it impossible to finish the gesture. Others report that the phone reads the first digit of a PIN as a complete entry, then immediately says the PIN is wrong. The result is the same in both cases: owners are locked out of their phones.
Reports have surfaced from users of the Pixel 10 Pro XL, Pixel 8a and Pixel 8 Pro, along with other models in Google's Pixel lineup. The mix of newer and older phones suggests the issue may be tied to software shared across the devices, rather than a hardware problem in one model.
That is what makes the bug more serious than a routine update problem. The lock screen is not just another part of the interface. It controls access to the phone and the data stored on it. If Android cannot properly register a PIN or unlock pattern, users may be shut out of photos, messages, files, apps and other information stored on the device.
One Pixel 10 Pro XL owner tried several ways to regain access. They restarted the phone, entered Safe Mode, cleaned the screen, connected a USB mouse and reinstalled the same Android build. None of those steps worked. The phone was eventually factory reset.
A reset may get the phone working again, but it comes with an obvious downside: it erases local data. That makes it a last resort, especially for people who do not have recent backups. Photos, downloads, app data and other files could be lost if they are not stored in the cloud or copied to another device.
Pixel 10 Pro XL – Can't unlock phone after September update (pattern resets after 2 dots)
by u/go6ka in GooglePixel
The reports also show why lock-screen bugs are difficult to troubleshoot. A phone might appear to be working normally in every other way. The display may respond to taps, and the user may know the correct PIN or pattern. But if the software handling the input is broken, the device may never receive the full credential in the form needed to unlock it.
Safe Mode can be useful when a third-party app is causing trouble, but it is less likely to help if the issue is part of the system update. Reinstalling the same build may not change anything either if the defect is in that version of Android. Using a mouse can help rule out a damaged display or touch-input problem, but it will not fix a lock-screen process that is misreading valid entries.
Google has not publicly confirmed the problem or announced a fix. It is also not clear how many users are affected, whether the issue is tied to a specific version of the update, or whether it appears only under certain security settings or device conditions.
For now, affected users should avoid a factory reset until they have checked for backups on another device or through their Google account. Contacting Google Pixel Support before wiping the phone may also be worthwhile, particularly if the company is gathering reports from users to identify the cause.

articles.title: AMD iGPUs To Get Promising Performance Boost on Linux via PerfOpt Patch
articles.text:
Wednesday, September 30th 2026
	
									
	
	
	
AMD iGPUs To Get Promising Performance Boost on Linux via PerfOpt Patch
The Linux kernel 7.4 is still a way out, with a late October/early November release anticipated, but it's already showing promising and usability updates for Linux PCs all around, with proper HDMI support with VRR and FreeSync support being just one example. A new patch called PerfOpt (Performance Optimization) is now slated to be merged into kernel 7.4, promising even more performance upgrades for AMD iGPUs. 
Per the recent Linux kernel mailing list, PerfOpt "allows privileged integrated I/O devices (GPUs) to bypass the IOMMU when directly accessing system memory. The IOMMU only enforces the IR/IW permission bits without GPA->SPA translations." Effectively, the patch reduces the amount of system overhead for the iGPU, which should result in a performance boost for basically any application that's sensitive to latency or throughput.According to testing by Phoronix, local LLM performance on an AMD Strix Halo APU can be improved by as much as 18-23%. PerfOpt should be relevant to basically everyone on an AMD iGPU, but it may be especially important for those on low-power devices, like the Valve Steam Deck and other AMD-powered handhelds, since they are already starved for GPU performance in many cases. There's no telling when Valve will update its SteamOS kernel to Linux 7.4, but distributions like CachyOS, which prioritize performance and fast updates, will likely see the patch sooner.

articles.title: FTC reportedly investigating OpenAI, Anthropic over potential consumer risks - SiliconANGLE
articles.text:
FTC reportedly investigating OpenAI, Anthropic over potential consumer risks
The U.S. Federal Trade Commission is reportedly investigating OpenAI Group PBC, Anthropic PBC and other artificial intelligence providers.
The New York Times today cited a source as saying that the probe covers multiple areas. According to the report, the FTC plans to review whether the companies have engaged in unfair or deceptive practices. Additionally, it’s believed the agency will “probably” investigate whether rogue AI agents have harmed consumers.
Last week, OpenAI revealed that rogue AI agents had posted ChaGPT users’ images to third-party websites on at least 53 occasions. The agents extracted the photos from the company’s AI training dataset. According to OpenAI, the dataset contained user photos because it incorporates prompts sent to the consumer editions of ChatGPT. The chatbot service offers a setting that enables consumers to opt out of AI training.
It’s possible the FTC is also concerned about the manner in which OpenAI processes healthcare data. In July, the company launched a set of features that enables ChatGPT to answer questions about users’ medical records. Healthcare data is subject to stricter regulations than many other types of information.
Earlier this month, the Wall Street Journal reported that the FTC was planning to investigate the impact of ChatGPT and other chatbots on children’s mental health.
It’s possible AI labs’ recent disclosures of AI-driven cyberattacks will also factor into the probe. Rogue AI agents tied to OpenAI and Anthropic have breached multiple organizations’ networks over the past few months. Last week, the former company disclosed the first such incident to have involved a government agency. Rogue OpenAI agents downloaded nonpublic data from Australia’s healthcare statistics agency.
The FTC is reportedly drafting civil investigative demands, or CIDs, as part of the probe. Those are formal requests for information about a potential regulatory violation. The FTC will reportedly issue the CIDs to OpenAI and Anthropic in the coming weeks.
The agency is also expected to scrutinize METR, a nonprofit AI safety lab. The organization helped OpenAI investigate its AI agents’ cyberattack against Hugging Face Inc. earlier this year. More recently, Anthropic hired METR to review cybersecurity incidents involving its own agents.
The FTC is reportedly growing its technology-focused regulatory team to support the probe. Further down the line, the agency is expected to seek testimony from top executives at the companies that it’s securitizing.
FTC investigations can lead to a formal lawsuit. The agency usually asks the presiding judge to issue fines or order the defendants to change their business practices. In many cases, companies implement the changes sought by the agency before going to court.

articles.title: Sony released the first CD audio player on this day in 1982 — player cost $3,700 when adjusted for inflation, but it would be another decade before the CD-ROM-driven multimedia PC era began
articles.text:
Sony released the first CD audio player on this day in 1982 — player cost $3,700 when adjusted for inflation, but it would be another decade before the CD-ROM-driven multimedia PC era began
The Sony CDP-101 cost around $1,060 at today’s exchange rate, or around $3,700 adjusted for inflation.
Sony launched the world’s first CD player on this day in 1982, kickstarting the compact disc digital audio era. The Sony CDP-101 was released to consumers in Japan, priced at JPY 168,000. That converts to $1,060 at today’s exchange rate, and is about $3,700 adjusted for inflation. CD players were meant to be a worldwide launch on October 1, 1982, but tech partner Philips didn’t have its CD100 ready, so Sony agreed to limit this initial event launch to Japan. Six months later, U.S. and European consumers would get their chance to buy a CD player, starting March 1983.
As for this first CD player hardware release for consumers from Sony. It wasn’t perfect, of course, and Wikipedia points out one particular limitation of the CDP-101: It had just one DAC for both left and right audio channels due to the high cost of these converters. Without sample-and-hold circuitry, this meant the stereo channels were approximately 11 μs out of sync.
Before CDs, home hi-fi setups of the era were typically built around vinyl records and compact audio cassette tapes. For a full set of separates, an enthusiast would also add a radio tuner, an amplifier, plus speakers - of course. Users of these older established pre-recorded audio media would have to cope with music affected by various imperfections over time. Vinyl sound quality would be a battle to maintain against the challenges of dust, scratches, warping, and wear. I remember pre-recorded cassettes had other problems, the major one for me being the variable quality of the tapes used by the distributors.
So, CDs came with many attractive promises, most importantly in the context of the early 1980s – providing digital music data that was read by a laser and wouldn’t wear. CDs also offered near-instant track selection, skipping, and replay. But most consumers would have to wait a few years: firstly for the price of player hardware to approach an acceptable level, and secondly for CD albums to become the norm for new releases and classic remasters.
Sony worked with CBS to have 50 CD albums on the shelves when the CDP-101 debuted in Japan. You’d think that six months later, when Philips joined in, and we saw the worldwide launch, that the catalog would have grown. Surprisingly, the ‘western’ launch was backed by just 16 titles.
It wouldn’t be until the mid-1980s when landmark DDD releases arrived and player prices dipped to much more acceptable levels that CDs would become established as a hi-fi staple. At around the same time, we started to get computers with built-in CD-ROM drives, but these would only start to become common from the early to mid 1990s and the dawn of the multimedia PC era.
If you are a retro tech fan who would be interested in buying a Sony CDP-101 before they all end up in museums, we noticed that you can buy them on eBay. At the time of writing, there were several of these 1982-vintage CD players for between $600 and $800.

articles.title: Critique Carrie (Prime Video) : Mike Flanagan réinvente avec brio le classique de Stephen King
articles.text:
| Réalisateur | Mike Flanagan | 
| Acteurs | Summer H. Howell, Samantha Sloyan, Siena Agudong, Alison Thornton, Matthew Lillard | 
| Genre | Epouvante-horreur | 
| Durée | 60 min | 
| Date de sortie | 07/10/2026 | 
| Episodes | 8 | 
Carrie, le roman culte de Stephen King, est une fois de plus adapté à l’écran, cette fois sous forme de série signée par le maître de l’horreur Mike Flanagan. Voici notre critique, garantie sans spoilers.
Que vous connaissiez déjà l’histoire de Carrie White ou non, préparez-vous à la (re)découvrir dans la série Carrie de Mike Flanagan. À travers huit épisodes qui modernisent l’histoire de la jeune fille aux pouvoirs télékinétiques, le créateur de The Haunting of Hill House et Sermons de minuit revisite le roman culte de Stephen King et le rend plus que jamais d’actualité.
Si on pouvait craindre qu’une énième adaptation de Carrie n’apporte pas grand-chose à cette histoire portée pour la première fois à l’écran par Brian De Palma en 1976, il ne fallait pas sous-estimer la créativité de Flanagan, qui signe ici sa meilleure adaptation de Stephen King. Découvrez notre critique de Carrie, garantie sans spoilers.
Carrie White est une lycéenne marginale qui a passé sa vie recluse entre les quatre murs de sa maison avec sa mère, Margaret, farouchement protectrice. Après la mort soudaine et prématurée de son père, qui la plonge dans l’univers impitoyable d’un lycée public, Carrie doit faire face à un scandale de harcèlement viral qui secoue sa communauté, à la pression incessante et à la cruauté désinvolte de l’ère des réseaux sociaux, ainsi qu’à l’éveil de mystérieux pouvoirs télékinétiques qui se manifestent parallèlement à son adolescence.
Comment de nouveau adapter Carrie ? Le premier roman de Stephen King a déjà donné lieu à trois films et une comédie musicale, alors que peut apporter une version sérielle à cette histoire culte de l'horreur moderne ? Mike Flanagan a trouvé la solution à ce challenge : approfondir l'univers de Carrie, mais aussi et surtout de lui donner un twist contemporain.
En 2026, Carrie ne fait pas du tout affaire à la même chose que celle des années 1970. La Carrie des temps modernes évolue à une époque où les réseaux sociaux sont rois, où la société est extrêmement polarisée et où l'innocence et la gentillesse sont perçues comme des faiblesses.
Cette Carrie White, qui n’est jamais allée plus loin que le jardin de ses parents, n’a donc pas les outils pour faire face à un tel environnement, et c'est exactement là-dessus que s'appuie cette nouvelle version de l'histoire de King.
Au cours des huit épisodes que compte la série, Flanagan développe l’histoire de Carrie White et des événements qui ont conduit à son tragique bal de promo en la confrontant à la dureté de la vie moderne, entre harcèlement en ligne et menace de fusillade, pour mieux nous rappeler que l’expérience d’un adolescent d’aujourd'hui n'a rien à voir avec celle des générations précédentes.
Pour aller plus loin, le showrunner change aussi la façon dont est présentée la mère de Carrie, Margaret White. Ici campée par l’incroyable Samantha Sloyan, elle est plus qu’une caricature de l’extremisme religieux et devient une femme endoctrinée qui a surtout à cœur de protéger son enfant d’un monde qu’elle juge trop à la dérive.
Les autres personnages de l’histoire sont aussi plus développés, comme Chris Hargensen et Sue Snell, non pas pour excuser leurs actes, mais principalement leur donner plus de contextes et d’explications. Cela rend ainsi le récit plus riche et son impact d’autant plus poignant.
L’horreur de la série ne se trouve pas dans ce que Carrie fait de ses pouvoirs surnaturels ou dans les effusions de sang, mais véritablement dans les rapports entre les ados de l'histoire et l'utilisation des réseaux sociaux comme arme.
Sous la houlette de Mike Flanagan, entouré d’une équipe de réalisatrices et scénaristes entièrement féminine, et grâce à l'interprétation pleine de justesse et de vulnérabilité de Summer H. Howell sous les traits de Carrie, ce récit culte est dépoussiéré et retrouve une grande pertinence auprès d’une nouvelle génération.
Alors si vous hésitiez à voir cette nouvelle version, car vous vous dites que l’histoire de Carrie White, on la connaît déjà, détrompez-vous. Vous ne l’avez jamais vu racontée comme ça.
Carrie est une série à découvrir sur Prime Video dès le 7 octobre 2026.
À travers une écriture et une mise en scène toujours aussi soignées, Mike Flanagan et ses acolytes plongent l’histoire de Carrie dans l’ère des réseaux sociaux et d’Internet, et la rendent plus saisissante et bouleversante que jamais. La scène des vestiaires, le bal de promo, les flammes, la série Carrie contient tous les ingrédients phares du roman de Stephen King et plus encore car elle remet au goût du jour ce récit culte et l’approfondit.

articles.title: OpenAI se enfrenta a una demanda que puede marcar un antes y un después: ¿Quién responde cuando una IA comete un delito?
articles.text:
El pasado mes de julio saltaba la noticia de que un modelo de OpenAI había escapado del entorno de pruebas y había hackeado los servidores de Hugging Face. Este incidente (el primero de muchos) fue la mecha que encendió el debate sobre los riesgos de una IA fuera de control. Sin embargo, el debate se ha centrado en cómo evitar nuevos incidentes y no tanto en una cuestión más inmediata: quién es responsable cuando un agente de IA se descontrola.
La demanda. Cuentan en Wired que OpenAI ha sido demandada por el incidente en el que cerca de 700 agentes colaboraron para infiltrarse en Hugging Face. Lo curioso es que quien demanda no es la propia Hugging Face, sino una organización sin ánimo de lucro llamada 'Defensores legales de la ciencia y la tecnología seguras' o LAAST, por sus siglas en inglés.
El delito. Según explica LAAST en un artículo publicado en su web, el ataque que ejecutaron los agentes de OpenAI viola varias leyes vigentes en California. La principal es la 'California Comprehensive Computer Data Access and Fraud Act', que básicamente es la ley anti-hackeo estatal. Los agentes accedieron a sistemas informáticos sin autorización, inyectaron malware y usaron servicios sin permiso.
Además, también dicen que violaron la ley de competencia desleal al mantener prácticas de desarrollo de IA consideradas inseguras y desproporcionadas: desactivaron clasificadores de seguridad cibernética, ejecutaron agentes en tareas “imposibles” y continuaron operando tras observar escapes de los entornos de contención, para luego publicar una carta abierta pidiendo priorizar la ciberdefensa pese a haber generado parte de la amenaza.
La responsabilidad. Es el punto clave de todo esto. Según LAAST, la excusa de que la IA actuó de forma autónoma no exime de responsabilidad a OpenAI. De hecho, explican que la ley en California lo contempla expresamente y que "no constituye una defensa alegar que la inteligencia artificial causó el daño de manera autónoma". Si el juez les da la razón, la responsabilidad pasa a ser de las empresas de IA, que se enfrentarían a consecuencias legales por los daños causados por sus modelos.
La IA no tiene la culpa. Hace poco lo decía Scott Bessent, secretario del Tesoro de EEUU: "el incidente de Hugging Face es responsabilidad de la administración de OpenAI, no de un grupo de agentes". Y añadía que es la medida más efectiva para que los laboratorios garanticen la seguridad de la IA.
En un reciente artículo publicado en el Wall Street Journal, Daniel Huttenlocher, decano del laboratorio de investigación de MIT, también era muy claro: "Los humanos tienen la culpa de los fallos de la IA".
Qué exigen. LAAST no reclama multas o indemnizaciones, lo que buscan con esta demanda es una orden judicial que cambie cómo opera OpenAI con sus agentes de IA. En concreto, piden prohibir el acceso a sistemas de terceros sin permiso, frenar prácticas de desarrollo consideradas inseguras (como desactivar clasificadores de ciberseguridad, ejecutar agentes en tareas "imposibles" y continuar tras escapes de los entornos de contención) y evitar que se repitan incidentes como el hackeo a Hugging Face. Su objetivo es preventivo, no económico, pero si ganan puede sentar jurisprudencia para futuros casos y cambiar las reglas del juego para los laboratorios.

articles.title: McDonald's usa IA para mudar preços e pressionar franqueados • Tecnoblog
articles.text:
McDonald’s usa IA para mudar preços e pressionar franqueados
Diferenças chegaram a 21% no preço do mesmo lanche entre lojas da mesma cidade.
O McDonald’s estaria usando um sistema de IA para recomendar preços aos franqueados, levando em conta quanto os consumidores de cada região estariam dispostos a pagar. A ferramenta pode resultar em valores substancialmente diferentes para o mesmo produto em uma mesma cidade dos Estados Unidos, segundo a Reuters.
Naquele país, a agência encontrou um Big Mac por US$ 5,69 em uma unidade e por US$ 6,89 em outra. Ambas estariam localizadas a cerca de 3,2 quilômetros de distância, em Fresno, na Califórnia. A diferença chega a 21%.
As ferramentas de precificação neste modelo são testadas pela rede pelo menos desde 2019, mas ganharam força há três anos, quando a empresa teria desenvolvido sistemas próprios de precificação. Franqueados relataram à agência recomendações consideradas agressivas, inclusive durante a pandemia.
A plataforma, visualizada pela Reuters, apresenta recomendações acompanhadas de dados sobre o comportamento dos consumidores. Uma das métricas indica a “sensibilidade” ao preço, que avalia a disposição dos clientes em pagar mais por determinados produtos. Ela também fornece recomendações de preços ao menos três vezes por ano.
O McDonald’s afirma que os franqueados são livres para definir os valores em cada loja e, em comunicado, classificou a investigação como “especulativa e desinformada”, ressaltando que a plataforma é apenas uma ferramenta de apoio.
Documentos analisados pela Reuters, no entanto, mostram que a companhia acompanha de perto a adesão às recomendações e registra quando os preços praticados se afastam dos valores sugeridos. A empresa também determina que os franqueados mantenham “engajamento construtivo com ferramentas e consultores de precificação aprovados pelo McDonald’s”.
Proprietários de restaurantes ouvidos pela reportagem afirmam que estariam sendo pressionados pela matriz com base nos valores sugeridos pela IA. Isso tudo, pelo visto, pode ter impacto nos processos de renovação de licenças. Segundo a agência, Kempczinski disse a investidores, em agosto, que o descumprimento de preços pode entrar nas negociações.
A precificação dinâmica é um dos vários usos de IA que já foram feitos pelo McDonald’s. Também em 2019, a companhia começou a testar a tecnologia para anotar pedidos no drive-thru, em parceria com a IBM. Isso foi descontinuado em 2024.
Os preços automatizados não são uma novidade no mercado. No setor de restaurantes, a Yum Brands, dona das marcas KFC e Taco Bell, continua investindo nesses sistemas e menus capazes de adaptar as opções exibidas no drive-thru.
Longe das praças de alimentação, companhias aéreas como a estadunidense Delta também pretendem adotar a IA para faturar mais.

articles.title: The RunStar 8E SmartScan Pro is punching well above its weight as a cheaper Withings BodyScan 2 rival
articles.text:
TechRadar Verdict
Sitting in the mid-range of body scales, the RunStar 8E SmartScan Pro delivers outstanding accuracy across the board. The separation of fat and muscle metrics across five body zones sets the 8E Pro apart from cheaper alternatives. On the flip side, the lack of heart health tracking shows its limitations compared to more expensive smart scales such as the Withings BodyScan 2. The overall build quality is solid, although the TFT-LCD display could be more robust.
Reasons to buy
- +Quick results
- +Measurements across five body zones
- +Well designed and engineered
- +Easy-to-use app
Reasons to avoid
- -TFT-LCD display feels cheap
- -Pretty basic app
- -No heart health tracking
Why you can trust TechRadar
RunStar 8E SmartScan Pro: One minute review
The RunStar 8E SmartScan Pro is one of the best smart scales designed for ease of health monitoring for the entire family, fitness enthusiasts who want metrics on their body fat and muscle, and general users desiring to track their body composition over time.
The smart scale delivers 28 metrics, which, for this price, is rather impressive. There’s also a pregnancy and baby mode, which offers safe measurements thanks to its zero-current technology (as opposed to most smart scales, which use electrical currents sent through the body to determine body composition). The only features I was left craving were heart-related, including heart rate and blood oxygen.
During testing, almost all results were within reasonable variation compared to the more expensive Withings BodyScan 2. Seven of the metrics are clearly displayed on the large color LCD display, with the full array of data presented in the easy-to-use Starfit app. If you can’t justify the extra spend, then the 8E Pro is a solid alternative to the top-range Withings.
Setting up the smart scale was easy thanks to the step-by-step guide in the app and a strong Bluetooth signal. I liked the ability to create multiple profiles so that every member of my family could use it. I also appreciated that it automatically detects who is standing on the scale, based on its previously recorded measurements.
The scale itself is well-built with 6mm tempered glass and gold-colored electrodes. The black plastic material used throughout the base and handlebar is solid and robust, with no concerns that damage would be done to the internals.
The display is a TFT-LCD, which delivers when it comes to clarity, brightness, and definition. Unfortunately, the display is covered by a thin layer of plastic that is flexible enough to allow a user to press it in and touch the screen itself, potentially causing damage.
All in, the RunStar 8E SmartScan Pro is a respectable smart scale that delivers accurate results inside a solid, compact body. If you can forgo heart health measurements and don’t mind a cheap-feeling display in comparison to the rest of the scale, then this smart scale will deliver everything you need.

RunStar 8E SmartScan Pro: Specifications
| Component | RunStar 8E SmartScan Pro | 
| Price | $219.99 USD / £218 GBP | 
| Dimensions | 14.92 x 16.96 x 2.75 in / 38 x 43 x 7 cm | 
| Weight | 5.29 lbs / 2.4 kg | 
| Material | 6 mm tempered glass | 
| Display | TFT-LCD | 
| Battery | 1x Lithium Polymer Battery, USB Type-C | 
| Connection | Bluetooth | 
RunStar 8E SmartScan Pro: Price and availability
- $219.99 USD / £218 GBP
- Not available in Australia
- Expensive but premium quality
RunStar sells a wide range of smart scales, with the budget-friendly RunStar 4E at the bottom end and the 8E Ultra at the other. Sitting just below their most premium Ultra offering is the RunStar 8E SmartScan Pro, to use its full title, at $219.99 USD / £218 GBP, although this is often significantly discounted, at times going as low as $129.98 / £168.
A similarly priced and specced alternative is the Withings BodyFit. Both are DEXA-validated, although the BodyFit claims to be “ideal for GLP-1 drug users who are prioritizing keeping muscle while losing fat.” If you’re looking for even more superior results and are happy paying a premium for it, then the Withings BodyScan 2 is a good choice.
- Value score 4/5
RunStar 8E SmartScan Pro: Design
- Large color TFT-LCD display
- Well-engineered retractable handlebar
- Eight electrodes and USB-C charging
The large 5 x 7 cm color screen displays seven key metrics: weight, heart rate, BMI, body fat, muscle mass, bone mass, and body water. Each metric is measured and presented one at a time before providing a full read-out of all seven metrics at the end. The display is clear and bright, although only protected by a thin layer of clear plastic, which is unfortunately so flexible that it presses in quite significantly when forced.
To measure 28 different metrics in total, which include the initial seven displayed on the scale plus additional metrics viewable in the app, the 8E Pro uses eight electrodes: four for the feet and four for the hands. These are positioned to accommodate a wide range of people with varying feet and hand sizes. The retractable handlebar used to connect your hands performs adequately and, when not in use, attaches to the base via magnets.
The bulk of the scale is made from strong plastic and covered in a thick 6 mm tempered glass, which protects the unit and houses the four foot electrodes. At the bottom of the base are four large rubber feet, which ensure the device remains in position at all times.
The overall design looks and feels premium, with the gold-colored electrodes setting the scale apart from cheaper and more basic alternatives. The unit contains a single non-removable lithium polymer battery that is recharged via USB-C. A full recharge lasts for three months. Despite regular use from five family members, we experienced zero issues with wear and tear.
- Design Score: 4.5/5
RunStar 8E SmartScan Pro: Features
- 28 metrics with DEXA validation
- Measurements across five body zones
- Delve deeper into the metrics with the Starfit app
RunStar says every metric reading is DEXA-validated with ≥98.5% correlation. Accurate results and precise body composition tracking are produced thanks to the advanced dual-frequency bioelectrical impedance analysis (BIA). This smart scale provides the features and accuracy for users who want to work towards a specific weight, track their health, and hit their fitness goals.
Unlike cheaper whole-body smart scales such as the RunStar 4E, the 8E Pro records measurements and provides analysis across five key body zones: arms, legs, and trunk. Providing weight and muscle data across five key areas of the body enables users to quickly see if their body is imbalanced and work towards specific goals for targeted areas of their body.
As well as viewing seven metrics on the display, if you sync the device with the Starfit app, you can see the full set of 28 metrics alongside more detailed tracking and analysis. The app is easy-to-use and laid out intuitively. If you plan on using the smart scale with multiple people, then up to 24 profiles can be set up using the app.
Other features include the ability to sync with Apple Health, Google Health and other major platforms as well as generate printable, clinic-grade reports. Finally, the 8E Pro operates with zero current, so it’s safe to use during pregnancy and with babies.
- Features Score: 4.5/5
RunStar 8E SmartScan Pro: Performance
- Accurate results
- Reliable data compared to the more expensive Withings BodyScan 2
- Metrics are clearly laid out
To provide comparison data, I took measurements from the Withings BodyScan 2 at the same time as the 8E Pro. Both are DEXA verified, with the BodyScan 2 validated up to 99% and the 8E Pro up to ≥98.5%. The two smart scales measure a similar set of metrics and are easily compared through the two apps.
Beginning with weight, I weighed in at 61.4 kg, which was only 170 grams different from the Withings. As for BMI, a reading of 19% wasn’t far off the 18.2% reported by the comparison scale. The 8E Pro is quick to deliver these measurements and does so prior to all other body composition metrics.
As for fat-related readings, the 8E Pro provided measurements for visceral fat, subcutaneous fat, and body fat percentage that were all within reasonable deviations compared to the Withings. When I came to measure body fat mass, I was surprised to find that it was the Withings that threw up problematic readings, and the 8E Pro proved significantly more accurate.
Accurate and acceptable readings continued for muscle rate, lean body mass, body water percentage, and basal metabolism. The app provides independent fat and muscle breakdowns for arms, legs, and trunk. Despite these being clearly presented as an overlay on a 2D illustration of a person, I much preferred the 3D graphic that is present in the Withings app.
The 8E Pro delivered similar results to the BodyScan 2 in almost all areas. Considering the 8E Pro costs half the price of the BodyScan 2, I think the RunStar is a useful and viable alternative for anyone wanting accurate results at a more affordable price.
- Performance score: 4.5/5

| Design | A well-built smart scale that is only let down by the cheap materials used on the display. | 4.5/5 |

RunStar 8E SmartScan Pro: Should I buy?
Buy it if...
You want to get serious about your health
Pinpoint accuracy and extensive metrics help users achieve their goals.
You want a whole family smart scale
Multiple profiles and automatic recognition deliver a multi-user experience.
Don't buy it if...

There are much cheaper and equally capable smart scale alternatives if these are all you want to measure.
You want a premium display
The TFT-LCD display on the 8E Pro feels cheap and basic.

A similarly priced smart scale with a comparable set of features. Boasts a slightly larger display and a more comprehensive app experience.

How I tested
I used the RunStar 8E SmartScan Pro across several weeks and set up multiple profiles so my four other family members could use the scale at the same time. This meant testing was carried out on both adults and children. We used the app in combination with the smart scale and were able to track our progress over time. articles.title: Así fue la intensa semana de Bill Gates en Nueva York: reuniones de alto nivel, Asamblea de la ONU, IA y más
articles.text:
A través de su cuenta de Instagram, el cofundador de Microsoft difundió los momentos centrales de su estadía en Nueva York. (Instagram/Bill Gates)
Bill Gates combinó diplomacia, medios y debate tecnológico durante su reciente visita a Nueva York, en una de las agendas más cargadas del año para el empresario. A través de su cuenta de Instagram, el cofundador de Microsoft difundió los momentos centrales de su estadía, que coincidió con la Asamblea General de la ONU y con la edición anual de Goalkeepers, el evento organizado por su fundación.
En el posteo, Gates calificó la semana como una de las más relevantes de su calendario anual y adjuntó un video que mostró su paso por conferencias, mesas de trabajo con jóvenes líderes e innovadores, grabaciones de podcasts y entrevistas televisivas.
PUBLICIDAD
Inteligencia artificial, equidad y ética: el diálogo con el Vaticano
Uno de los puntos centrales de la agenda se dio en el foro Goalkeepers 2026, realizado el 21 y 22 de septiembre bajo el lema Make This Matter: AI, Equity, and the Choice We Can’t Delay” (Haz que esto importe: IA, equidad y la elección que no podemos retrasar). Allí, Gates protagonizó una conversación pública con el arzobispo Vincenzo Paglia, titular de la Pontificia Academia para la Vida del Vaticano.
Durante el intercambio, Paglia planteó la necesidad de imponer restricciones al avance acelerado de la inteligencia artificial y sostuvo que “tenemos que humanizar la tecnología, no lo contrario”, al remarcar que esta debe entenderse como un instrumento y no como un fin en sí mismo.
PUBLICIDAD
El religioso inició la charla con una frase que definió el tono del encuentro: “No tengo miedo de la IA. Tengo miedo de la estupidez humana”. Gates respondió con una sonrisa, y el arzobispo completó la idea al señalar que ese es justamente el problema, y que resulta necesario imaginar un mundo nuevo para todas las personas, naciones y circunstancias de la vida.
La IA es una herramienta cuyo desarrollo debe subordinarse a criterios éticos que prioricen a las personas por encima de la eficiencia técnica: esa fue la idea central que atravesó el diálogo entre Gates y Paglia, quienes coincidieron en que el avance tecnológico no puede desligarse de la dimensión humana y moral.
PUBLICIDAD
Frente a estos planteos, Gates destacó como positivo que la ciencia y la religión coincidan en una misma pregunta: qué se busca preservar para no perder la humanidad en el proceso. El arzobispo cerró el intercambio al insistir en que la tecnología debe emplearse para fortalecer la compasión humana.
Gobernanza tecnológica y geopolítica
La presencia de Paglia en el evento organizado por la Fundación Gates no fue casual, sino resultado de un vínculo sostenido en el tiempo. Según Religion News Service, el arzobispo ya había mantenido un encuentro privado de dos horas con Gates tres meses antes del foro, y volvió a reunirse a solas con él el 21 de septiembre.
PUBLICIDAD
Desde el Vaticano se impulsa el concepto de algor-ética, un esquema de gobernanza orientado a que el desarrollo de la inteligencia artificial se rija por principios morales explícitos.
En paralelo, la Academia Pontificia para la Vida y otras comisiones vinculadas trabajan para que los países en desarrollo no queden marginados frente a la competencia tecnológica entre potencias como Estados Unidos y China, de acuerdo con lo reportado por la agencia Zenit.
La agenda de Gates, además, tiene un componente geopolítico explícito: tras reunirse con el presidente Donald Trump y su equipo, manifestó su intención de encontrarse también con el presidente chino Xi Jinping, en un recorrido que busca vincular la innovación tecnológica con el compromiso ético y los Objetivos de Desarrollo Sostenible a nivel global.
PUBLICIDAD
Bill Gates se reunió con líderes de Pakistán y Catar
Bill Gates protagonizó una semana intensa de actividad diplomática y filantrópica en Nueva York, en el marco de la Semana de Alto Nivel de la 81.ª Asamblea General de la ONU, celebrada en septiembre de 2026.
El copropietario de la Fundación Gates combinó reuniones bilaterales con jefes de Estado y encuentros centrados en tres ejes: el desarrollo de la inteligencia artificial, la salud global y la agricultura.
Su agenda se desarrolló en paralelo a la de otros líderes internacionales, que en esos mismos días se presentaban ante el Consejo de Seguridad de la organización. Gates, en cambio, concentró sus compromisos en el plano filantrópico, con encuentros bilaterales que reunieron a mandatarios de distintas regiones del mundo y que abarcaron desde la cooperación agrícola hasta la salud pública.
PUBLICIDAD
Uno de los encuentros centrales de la semana fue la reunión bilateral entre Gates y Shehbaz Sharif, primer ministro de Pakistán, realizada en los márgenes de la Asamblea. El encuentro sirvió para acordar líneas de cooperación en tecnologías agrícolas avanzadas, entre ellas el desarrollo de semillas mejoradas y avances en genética de ganado, dos áreas consideradas por la fundación como parte de su trabajo en seguridad alimentaria.
La reunión con Sharif abordó además la erradicación de la polio, un objetivo histórico de la Fundación Gates a nivel global, junto con proyectos de innovación digital y salud pública para Pakistán.
La cooperación acordada entre ambos se centró así en cuatro ejes concretos: tecnologías agrícolas como semillas mejoradas y genética de ganado, erradicación de la polio, innovación digital y fortalecimiento de la salud pública, todos discutidos durante un encuentro bilateral en el marco de la Asamblea General de la ONU.
PUBLICIDAD
Otro de los encuentros destacados de la semana fue el sostenido con Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al Thani, primer ministro y ministro de Asuntos Exteriores de Catar.
La reunión bilateral tuvo lugar el lunes de esa semana, en el mismo período de actividad diplomática que rodeó a la Asamblea General, y sirvió para que ambas partes intercambiaran perspectivas sobre cooperación internacional y temas de interés mutuo, sin que el intercambio se circunscribiera a un área temática específica como en el caso de Pakistán.
Este tipo de reuniones bilaterales forma parte del patrón habitual de Gates durante la Semana de Alto Nivel, en la que aprovecha la concentración de mandatarios en Nueva York para sostener encuentros puntuales con distintos gobiernos, combinando temas de salud, tecnología y cooperación internacional según el interlocutor.
PUBLICIDAD
Coincidencia con Sam Altman en la agenda de inteligencia artificial
Durante esa misma semana, Gates compartió el protagonismo de la agenda tecnológica global con otras figuras vinculadas al desarrollo de la inteligencia artificial. Entre ellas se destacó Sam Altman, director ejecutivo de OpenAI, cuya presencia en Nueva York coincidió con la de Gates en esos días, aunque ambos sostuvieron agendas paralelas y diferenciadas.
Mientras Gates lideraba los compromisos filantrópicos de salud e inteligencia artificial de su fundación, otros líderes internacionales se presentaban ante el Consejo de Seguridad de la ONU en el marco de la misma Semana de Alto Nivel.
La coincidencia entre ambas figuras se dio en el contexto de los llamados internacionales urgentes para regular los riesgos asociados al desarrollo de la inteligencia artificial, un tema que atravesó buena parte de las discusiones sostenidas durante la semana en Nueva York.
PUBLICIDAD
PUBLICIDAD

articles.title: Google Home reçoit une avalanche de nouveautés
articles.text:
Les utilisateurs inscrits au programme d’accès anticipé à Gemini pour Home profitent d’une vague d’améliorations, ainsi que tous les utilisateurs de l’application Google Home. Google revoit sa copie pour rendre son assistant plus réactif et tolérant face aux petits tracas du quotidien, ce qui est toujours bon à prendre.
Des commandes vocales améliorées
L’assistant s’améliore notamment dans les environnements bruyants grâce à un meilleur filtrage des conversations de fond, ce qui évite que l’appareil ignore les requêtes que vous pouvez formuler au milieu du brouhaha. La latence est également réduite sur pas mal de commandes courantes qui touchent aux alarmes, aux minuteurs et à la domotique. La fonction permettant de localiser son smartphone par la voix devient aussi plus fiable.
Les foyers multilingues dans lesquels trois langues sont parlées régulièrement profitent aussi d’une meilleure reconnaissance pour limiter les malentendus. Les instructions personnalisées intégrées aux routines s’exécutent de manière plus prévisible, et les erreurs où Gemini répétait en boucle qu’il ne comprenait pas ne devraient plus arriver.
Des correctifs pour l’application mobile
Côté application, le curseur de luminosité des ampoules connectées envoie enfin une commande d’extinction définitive lorsqu’il est poussé à zéro pour cent, ce qui évite d’avoir un éclairage résiduel. Les tuiles des caméras et des sonnettes affichent des icônes pleines pour identifier d’un coup d’œil les flux qui sont actifs. On note également que l’état hors connexion des interrupteurs Matter s’affiche correctement en gris.
À lire : Test Google Home Speaker avec Gemini : une révolution vocale au son décevant
L’application facilite aussi l’installation du matériel Nest sur iOS et Android en corrigeant les décrochages Bluetooth et Wi-Fi, tout en permettant de mettre en cache les identifiants réseau pour enchaîner l’ajout de plusieurs accessoires. Divers correctifs viennent stabiliser l’ensemble, qu’il s’agisse du chargement de l’historique vidéo sur les caméras ou de la gestion des stores et des rideaux. Google ne s’est pas moqué de nous avec cette dernière mise à jour.

articles.title: The Pentagon is creating a new command just for autonomous and robotic warfare
articles.text:
What just happened? In yet another move highlighting the military's evolution toward a future in which machines do the fighting, Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth has announced the creation of a new military command designed to expand the use of autonomous and robotic capabilities across the US armed forces. It's called the Autonomous Warfare Command, or the slightly sinister AutoWarCom.
Hegseth announced the initiative during his September 30 State of the Force address at Quantico, Virginia. A four-star officer will lead the command, which would join the military's existing 11 combatant commands. The last addition was US Space Command in 2019.
"The pace of war is changing faster than the process to support it," Hegseth said (via Reuters) in a speech that also included the announcement of an office of religious affairs.
"Cheap compute, superintelligence, and advanced commercial manufacturing have enabled the proliferation of low-cost, high-precision strike," Hegseth added.
As is always the case, there's some bureaucracy to navigate before AutoWarCom becomes a reality. Air & Space Forces Magazine reports that the Pentagon aims to establish it by October 1, 2027, working with Congress on the necessary authorization. Its remit will cover drones, AI, and command and control systems, though its leadership and precise structure remain unclear.
The command is supposed to accelerate the development and deployment of autonomous and semi-autonomous systems. Hegseth also wants the services to introduce military specialties focused on autonomy, giving personnel dedicated career paths in this field.
War is expensive. It was reported in July that the US lost an estimated $1 billion worth of Reaper drones during its campaign against Iran. The Pentagon's Massed Modular Aircraft project seeks cheaper, modular aircraft that can be fielded in larger numbers, with losses expected. When drones are being shot down regularly, the military would prefer replacements that don't cost a small fortune.
"Today we need both quality and quantity," Hegseth said.
The announcement is another example of how humanoid robots are making their way into militaries. It was reported this week that the Army selected five winners in its xTechHumanoid competition, including Alex the robot from the Florida Institute for Human and Machine Cognition. Despite the very ordinary name, it features ballistic protection and combines AI with human control for dangerous missions.
China doesn't want to be left behind in this race. The US rival has investigated military uses for humanoids, including reconnaissance, logistics, and potential building-clearing operations alongside troops.
AI's military role already extends beyond controlling machines to include intelligence analysis, logistics, and targeting. That also means a hallucination can have considerable consequences. It was recently reported that US forces nearly intercepted a Chinese vessel after an AI-assisted intelligence report falsely identified its cargo as materials for a nuclear weapons program. Personnel were preparing to board and aircraft were already airborne before officials scrutinized the report. A human review caught the error, but only after preparations were already underway.

articles.title: Russian missile strikes take out popular piracy websites — Russo-Ukrainian war temporarily achieves what lawmakers can't, world's second-biggest torrent tracker suffers 'Direct Destruction of Server' downtime before rebounding
articles.text:
Russian missile strikes take out popular piracy websites — Russo-Ukrainian war temporarily achieves what lawmakers can't, world's second-biggest torrent tracker suffers 'Direct Destruction of Server' downtime before rebounding
As one commenter put it, "DDoS now means Direct Destruction of Servers."
The Russo-Ukrainian war has now formally extended to the digital realm. Over the last week, there have been multiple reports that the Russian military has started targeting Ukraine's data centers. Although the Western world didn't feel much of an impact, the situation is now changing, as popular pirate websites that host torrent trackers 1337x (aka Leet X) and NordicQuality experienced periods of explosion-induced downtime.
1337x has been fighting standard-issue DDoS attacks for months on end, and now it's experienced a Direct Destruction of Server attack, as several machines in its network were brought offline by kinetic blasts. Likewise, Norse tracker NordicQuality was also temporarily down for the same reason. Both sites are online again, though don't be surprised if the seas are unsteady for the pirates.
The servers for this type of site are rarely directly visible to the internet, relying instead on content delivery networks like Cloudflare. As such, it's hard to tell which Ukrainian data center firm is hosting them.
Virtual Systems reported strikes on the 23rd of September, which took down both its facilities, at least temporarily. MiroHost Ukraine got completely destroyed; strikes on CosmoNova took down TV channels; DataGroup and CityHost also got hit; telco KyivStar saw its Kyiv headquarters hit, while Russian authorities claim Vodafone Ukraine was also struck. Most of the strikes were clustered around Kyiv, prompting several of these companies to move operations to other regions or countries.
The 1337x tracker has been online for 19 years now, and has survived several shutdown and redirection attempts, including a blacklisting by Google and blacklisting across multiple countries' ISPs. Despite that, it remains the second most-visited pirating tracker, at around 40-50 million monthly visits, clearly displaying how neither laws nor guided missiles seem to be effective in curbing piracy.
Ukraine, Russia, and other countries in Eastern Europe have proven a popular choice for hosting torrent- and piracy-related websites, thanks to the region's general lax approach to copyright law, legal liability (or lack thereof), and difficulty in identifying website operators. Having said that, Ukraine is shifting its legal stance on the matter to more closely align with the European Union, likely as part of its bid for membership in the bloc.

articles.title: Raspberry Pi augmente à nouveau le prix de ses cartes les plus populaires
articles.text:
Raspberry Pi augmente à nouveau le prix de ses cartes les plus populaires
Le marché des composants électroniques subit une pression croissante liée aux coûts de production. Raspberry Pi annonce une nouvelle hausse tarifaire pour les modèles ayant échappé à la précédente.
Face à la hausse du coût de la mémoire vive enregistrée depuis fin 2025, la Fondation Raspberry Pi réajuste sa grille tarifaire. Cette hausse est due à la pénurie de RAM qui met actuellement le marché en tension. Après avoir maintenu ses tarifs lors de la précédente révision en avril dernier sur les modèles ayant le moins de mémoire vive, l'entreprise indique ne plus pouvoir absorber ces surcoûts sur l'ensemble de ses modèles. Il s'agit de la quatrième hausse observée depuis le 1er décembre 2025.
Les modèles de 2 Go concernés par le réajustement
À compter de ce jour, le prix des versions 2 Go du Raspberry Pi 4 et du Raspberry Pi 5 augmente de 12,50 $. Le Raspberry Pi 4 2 Go passe ainsi à 67,50 $, tandis que le Raspberry Pi 5 doté de la même quantité de mémoire atteint 77,50 $.
Cette hausse s'applique uniquement à ces deux déclinaisons. Les autres références du catalogue conservent leur tarif actuel, notamment les versions 1 Go des Raspberry Pi 4 et 5, ainsi que les Compute Modules 4 et 5 dotés de 2 Go de RAM.
Des recommandations à destination des utilisateurs
Afin de minimiser l'impact budgétaire sur les projets, la marque conseille d'évaluer les besoins réels en ressources matérielles avant tout achat. Elle suggère par exemple d'envisager des modèles plus anciens, comme les Raspberry Pi 3B, 3A+ ou 3B+, lorsque les performances requises sont plus limitées.
Par ailleurs, l'entreprise met en garde contre les revendeurs non agréés appliquant des prix élevés ou fournissant des produits non conformes, en recommandant de s'adresser à son réseau de revendeurs agréés. Même si le contexte d'approvisionnement reste complexe, le fabricant indique que ces variations de prix n'ont pas un caractère définitif et prévoit de réajuster ses tarifs lorsque le marché de la mémoire se stabilisera.

articles.title: Microsoft melhora ainda mais a integração entre Linux e Windows • Tecnoblog
articles.text:
Microsoft melhora ainda mais a integração entre Linux e Windows
Microsoft liberou oficialmente o WSL Containers (WSLC), trazendo suporte nativo a contêineres no Linux executado via Windows 11.
A Microsoft acaba de dar um reforço e tanto na integração do Windows 11 com o ecossistema do Linux. Isso porque a companhia liberou oficialmente o suporte a contêineres no Windows Subsystem for Linux (WSL), recurso interessante principalmente para desenvolvedores.
Se você está “boiando” no assunto, aqui vai uma rápida explicação: o WSL é uma ferramenta que executa determinadas distribuições Linux em ambiente Windows, dispensando o usuário de rodar máquinas virtuais ou de depender de dual boot para esse fim em determinados cenários. O WSL foi introduzido no Windows 10 e vem sendo melhorado significativamente no Windows 11.
Pois bem, o suporte a contêineres é uma dessas melhorias. Entenda um contêiner como um pacote que combina uma aplicação junto com as suas dependências (bibliotecas, arquivos de configuração, módulos, entre outros), de modo a permitir a sua execução padronizada em diferentes ambientes computacionais.
Desenvolvedores, administradores de TI e afins já podiam trabalhar com contêineres no WSL, mas dependiam de soluções de terceiros para isso. Com a atualização do Windows Subsystem for Linux, a própria ferramenta passa a ter suporte nativo para o recurso.
O WSL Containers (WSLC), como é chamado oficialmente, foi anunciado em junho, durante a Build 2026. A ferramenta foi sendo testada e aprimorada para ser liberada massivamente agora, junto com a chegada da versão 26H2 do Windows 11, ainda que ambas as novidades não estejam interligadas (o WSL é focado no Windows 11 atualmente, mas também funciona no Windows 10 e no Windows Server).
O WSL Containers funciona por meio de uma interface de linha de comando (CLI, na sigla em inglês). Eis alguns exemplos, sendo a maioria destacada pela própria Microsoft:
O último comando é o mais importante porque, efetivamente, coloca o WSLC em ação. Para isso, ele depende de alguns parâmetros. Um exemplo simples é o comando abaixo (mostrado também na imagem de abertura deste texto), que ativa um ambiente Ubuntu, o faz exibir a mensagem “Hello, world!” (comando echo) e depois exclui o contêiner (parâmetro –rm):
wslc run --rm ubuntu:latest bash -c "echo Hello, world!"
Um detalhe interessante é que o WSLC também pode ser executado por meio de uma API. Assim, é possível fazer aplicações para Windows executarem contêineres no WSL de modo direto, o que pode ser útil para automação de determinadas tarefas, por exemplo.
Para ter acesso à novidade, basta digitar o comando wsl –update no PowerShell ou Prompt de Comando para atualizar o WSL (é preciso ter a versão 2.9.3 ou superior). Se a ferramenta não estiver instalada, a instale via comando wsl –install.
Há mais instruções sobre como usar o WSLC na documentação oficial.

articles.title: Destro AI raises $8M to coordinate mixed robot fleets in enterprise warehouses - SiliconANGLE
articles.text:
Destro AI raises $8M to coordinate mixed robot fleets in enterprise warehouses
Warehouse robotics software startup Destro AI Inc. has raised $8 million in new funding to bring its platform for coordinating mixed robot fleets to more enterprise warehouses, using the funds partly to hire more engineers and researchers.
Destro provides software that tells warehouse robots what to do, whichever company built them. “Everyone is building capable robots,” said founder and Chief Executive Manthan Pawar, who expects the next breakthrough to come from “the intelligence layer that enables any robot to work together.”
The coordination system is called MothershipOS. Sitting outside any one robot, the software assigns each task across a mixed fleet, down to when and where the work happens. Mobile manipulation is handled on the robots by a second system, VisionOS, built on artificial intelligence models that learned from human demonstrations how to perceive and grasp objects.
Customers can run machines from several vendors under one system and swap hardware as their operations change. With regulations and supply chains around robotics still shifting, Destro is betting that warehouse operators will want an automation strategy that does not hang on one manufacturer.
Yusen Logistics (Americas) Inc. is the one customer Destro names. The logistics company said in August that it was deploying the platform in its transload operations. The first pilot, at a Yusen facility in the Pacific Northwest, used three cart-moving robots built by Miva Robotics, TechCrunch reported. That site is moving to a full deployment of 26 robots, and a 17-robot pilot is starting at a Yusen facility in Southern California.
Rick Brunelle, Yusen’s director of automation, said the platform gives his teams “a new level of intelligence and control” across its transload workflows.
Destro is less than a year old and already booking revenue, and Pawar told TechCrunch the company is “on path to be cash flow positive at the end of this year.” The company also says it has won head-to-head evaluations against competitors valued at $1 billion or more.
The Brooklyn company’s founding team came from Hai Robotics Co. Ltd., Dexterity Inc. and Matic Robots Inc. Pawar holds a master’s degree in robotics from New York University’s Tandon School of Engineering.
The seed round was co-led by Base10 Partners Management and Bonfire Ventures Management, with CoFound Partners joining as a third backer.
Adeyemi Ajao, co-founder and managing partner at Base10, said Destro had two pilots running when the firm first met Pawar and was “live in production with some of the largest logistics operators in the country” a few months later.
“We’ve spent enough time around warehouses and logistics networks to know that operational complexity is where good ideas go to die,” said Jennifer Richard, a principal at Bonfire. “The gap between a successful demo and a successful deployment is enormous.”

articles.title: Por qué varios móviles de Apple se quedan sin Apple Intelligence en 2026: la lista de dispositivos incompatibles
articles.text:
Apple dejó fuera a una parte considerable de su base de usuarios del acceso a Apple Intelligence, el conjunto de funciones de inteligencia artificial que la compañía integró en su ecosistema de dispositivos. La razón no tiene que ver con la antigüedad del sistema operativo, sino con el hardware interno de cada equipo.
Numerosos modelos de iPhone, aunque reciban actualizaciones de iOS, carecen del procesador y la memoria necesarios para ejecutar estas herramientas.
PUBLICIDAD
La noticia expone una nueva brecha entre generaciones de teléfonos. Mientras algunos usuarios podrán acceder a asistencia para escritura, edición de contenido y generación de imágenes mediante inteligencia artificial, otros seguirán operando con sus dispositivos actualizados pero sin ninguna de estas funciones disponibles.
Qué es Apple Intelligence y por qué algunos iPhone no pueden usarlo
Apple Intelligence es el nombre que la compañía dio a su sistema de funciones de inteligencia artificial integradas en los dispositivos. Permite asistir en tareas como la escritura, la edición de contenido y la generación de imágenes, entre otras capacidades.
El acceso a estas herramientas no depende únicamente de contar con una versión reciente del sistema operativo. El dispositivo debe tener, además, un hardware compatible capaz de procesar las tareas de aprendizaje automático que la tecnología demanda.
PUBLICIDAD
Esto significa que Apple Intelligence son las funciones de inteligencia artificial de Apple para escritura, edición e imágenes, disponibles solo en iPhone con chip A17 Pro o superior y 8 GB de RAM como mínimo, sin importar si el equipo cuenta con la última versión de iOS instalada.
La limitación surge porque estas tareas requieren procesar determinados modelos de aprendizaje automático directamente en el dispositivo. Sin un chip con la potencia adecuada, el teléfono no puede ejecutar esas cargas de trabajo de manera local.
La lista de iPhone incompatibles con Apple Intelligence
Son varios los modelos que, pese a mantenerse activos dentro de la base de usuarios de Apple, quedan excluidos de estas funciones. Entre ellos se encuentran el iPhone 11, el iPhone 11 Pro y el 11 Pro Max.
PUBLICIDAD
También integran ese grupo el iPhone 12, el 12 mini, el 12 Pro y el 12 Pro Max, junto con toda la familia del iPhone 13: el modelo base, el mini, el Pro y el Pro Max.
La lista continúa con el iPhone 14, el 14 Plus, el 14 Pro y el 14 Pro Max. A ese conjunto se suman, además, el iPhone 15 y el iPhone 15 Plus, en sus versiones estándar.
La presencia de estos dos últimos modelos resulta particular, dado que pertenecen a una generación reciente. Sin embargo, no comparten el mismo procesador que sus variantes Pro, lo que determina su exclusión.
PUBLICIDAD
Qué modelos sí pueden ejecutar las funciones de inteligencia artificial
Entre los equipos compatibles se ubican el iPhone 15 Pro y el iPhone 15 Pro Max, que incorporan el chip A17 Pro. Este procesador constituye el punto de partida para acceder a Apple Intelligence.
A partir de la familia iPhone 16, la compañía amplió la disponibilidad de estas funciones a más modelos, junto con las generaciones posteriores que también integran procesadores compatibles.
De esta manera, el chip se transforma en un factor determinante junto a las mejoras habituales que Apple suele destacar en cada lanzamiento, como cámaras, batería o rendimiento general.
Los requisitos técnicos de chip y memoria RAM
El factor decisivo no es el año de lanzamiento del dispositivo ni la versión de iOS instalada, sino el hardware interno con el que fue fabricado cada modelo.
PUBLICIDAD
Para ejecutar las funciones avanzadas de Apple Intelligence directamente en el dispositivo, sin depender de servidores externos, Apple exige dos condiciones. La primera es un procesador con un Neural Engine potente, es decir, un chip A17 Pro o superior.
La segunda condición establece un mínimo estricto de 8 gigabytes (GB) de memoria RAM. Sin ese umbral, el equipo no cuenta con la capacidad suficiente para procesar las tareas que estas herramientas demandan.
Estos dos requisitos explican por qué los modelos comprendidos entre el iPhone 11 y el iPhone 15 en sus versiones base y Plus quedan fuera del sistema, independientemente de si reciben iOS 18 o actualizaciones posteriores.
PUBLICIDAD
Por qué el iPhone 15 no accede a Apple Intelligence
El caso del iPhone 15 y el iPhone 15 Plus resulta representativo de esta división técnica. Ambos modelos cuentan con 6 GB de RAM o menos, por debajo del mínimo que exige la compañía.
A esto se suma que utilizan el chip A16 Bionic, un procesador anterior al A17 Pro. Esa combinación de memoria y capacidad de procesamiento impide que puedan ejecutar las herramientas de inteligencia artificial en el dispositivo.
En consecuencia, aunque estos modelos reciban las actualizaciones de software más recientes, permanecen al margen de las funciones que sí están disponibles en sus versiones Pro y en la familia iPhone 16 en adelante.

articles.title: Motorola Razr 60 atinge menor preço dos últimos meses em oferta na Amazon • Tecnoblog
articles.text:
Motorola Razr 60 atinge menor preço dos últimos meses em oferta na Amazon
Razr 60 (256 GB) tem mais RAM física e as mesmas telas do Razr 70; dobrável da Motorola registra desconto de 46% e um dos menores preços recentes em oferta no Pix
O Motorola Razr 60 de 256 GB está saindo por apenas R$ 2.969 no Pix na Amazon. O celular dobrável da Motorola, que traz as mesmas telas do novo Razr 70, alcança o menor preço desde julho de 2026, segundo o histórico da plataforma de monitoramento Zoom, com desconto de 46% sobre o original de R$ 5.499.
O Razr 60 traz as mesmas telas do novo Razr 70: interna dobrável é uma POLED de 6,9″ com taxa de 120 Hz e brilho de até 3.000 nits, que reproduz cores excelentes com alta fluidez nas transições, além de visibilidade garantida em qualquer lugar. A externa POLED de 3,6″ suporta Always-On e ações rápidas.
Seu chip MediaTek Dimensity 7400X e os 12 GB de RAM física suportam multitarefa e apps pesados, enquanto o Razr 70 possui apenas 8 GB. Os 256 GB de armazenamento permitem guardar uma quantidade adequada de vídeos e fotos.
O kit de câmeras é formado por uma wide de 50 MP com OIS e uma ultrawide de 13 MP, que captam belas cenas ao ar livre, e uma frontal de 32 MP que tira ótimas selfies em alta resolução. Todas filmam em 4K.
O copo de alumínio com dobradiças de titânio do Razr 60 é reforçado pelo vidro Gorilla Glass Victus sobre a tela externa, resistente contra pancadas e quedas. A certificação IP48 confere proteção contra poeira moderada e mergulhos acidentais.
Sua bateria de 4.500 mAh suporta carregamento rápido de 30 W. Segundo a fabricante, ela permite ao gadget receber uma carga para 12 horas de uso em apenas 15 minutos, um excelente recurso para quem não quer se preocupar com carregadores e tomadas.
O Motorola Razr 60 de 256 GB (apenas R$ 2.969 no Pix) foi atualizado para o Android 16 e deve receber mais dois updates do sistema operacional. O celular conversa com redes 5G, Wi-Fi 6E, Bluetooth 5.4 e NFC.
Aviso de ética: ao clicar em um link de afiliado, o preço não muda para você e recebemos uma comissão.

articles.title: Geekbench 7 results suggest OpenAI’s dots agent runs on nine-core AMD EPYC VMs with nearly 10GB of memory — newest runs score about six times Meta Muse in multi-core
articles.text:
Geekbench 7 results suggest OpenAI’s dots agent runs on nine-core AMD EPYC VMs with nearly 10GB of memory — newest runs score about six times Meta Muse in multi-core
The 9,435 multi-core score posted on X was uploaded four days before the launch.
A pre-launch Geekbench 7 result, shared on X by INIYSA as one of OpenAI’s dots (it's answer to Meta's Muse), shows a multi-core score of 9,435, with indications of the hardware used by the new autonomous agent. The VM hardware appears to be a single nine-core slice of an AMD EPYC 9V74 with 9.73GB of memory, run on Ubuntu for the leak and Debian for post-launch runs. Our check of Geekbench 7’s public database found six runs on that configuration uploaded since launch, ranging from 1,512 to 1,614 single-core and 8,135 to 8,991 multi-core. Dots, powered by GPT-6 Astra, launched at OpenAI’s DevDay on Tuesday for Pro and Business Premium users.
OpenAI bills the autonomous agents as having “their own cloud computer, their own browser, and the apps you’ve connected” in its introduction. This is not a new concept: Cursor says its cloud agents get their own virtual machines; SpaceXAI says every Grok Bot shares one persistent cloud computer; and Meta’s Muse gives each agent a sandbox. 
Maddie D. Reese posted on X on launch day the apps her dot said came preloaded. The lineup includes Chromium, Blender, GIMP, Inkscape, Kdenlive, Godot, FreeCAD, OpenSCAD, KiCad, QGIS, ParaView, 3D Slicer, with Python, Node.js, and Git. In the same reply, the dot said its cloud computer runs “Debian Linux.”
The post went up the evening of launch day, captioned “OpenAI dots Geekbench 7 Score,” with a screenshot showing a single-core score of 1,667 and multi-core of 9,435. The result in the screenshot shows that it was uploaded Sept. 25, or four days before the launch. The 9,435 is almost 5% higher than the post-launch best and about 10% higher than the median. The pre-launch run is potentially a bit of an outlier, but performance remains within the same ballpark. It is uncertain who ran the original benchmark.
Tom’s Hardware previously reported that rival Meta’s Muse runs on AMD EPYC Turin with two cores and 8GB per sandbox. The 10 Muse runs in Geekbench’s database have median scores of about 1,041 single-core and 1,394 multi-core. The dot’s post-launch runs, with median scores of 1,570 and about 8,550, put it at about 1.5x the single-core and 6x the multi-core score.
Some of this gap is accounted for by the nine-core vs. two-core configuration; the rest of the gap likely comes from a difference in clock speed, partially offset by Muse’s newer architecture. Geekbench lists a 2.6GHz base clock for the dot’s EPYC 9V74 against 1.5GHz for Muse’s EPYC 9D25.
Muse’s runs also report 7.75GB of memory. Our independent run for this article came back with a single-core score of 1,000 and a multi-core score of 1,433, in line with the other Muse runs.
Data center CPU demand for always-on agents has surged as high-core-count CPUs are needed at sustained load. It is unknown whether the dots, as tested, hold their cores while idle. Such agents are rising in popularity: Muse reportedly passed 500,000 daily active users, and SpaceXAI plans standalone Nvidia Vera CPUs for Grok’s agentic workloads. It may only be a matter of time before a new CPU arms race begins. OpenAI has already said that, in the future, users will be able to add more dots and “scale the output of each dot by ... increasing its speed.”
